Name: Better Butterfly Hutch
Author: NormanPCN
Description:
[size=3]I like to put a Butterfly Hutch in the Greenhouse. The butterfly hutch in the game all too often spawns very few butterflies. I got tired of this so I wrote this mod.[/size]

[size=3]This mod lets you specify a range for the number of butterflies to spawn in the location of the hutch. You can specify different ranges for indoor and outdoor locations. This mod also lets you set the number of Bat Wings required in trade for a hutch at the Desert Trader. The Vanilla value is quite high given that the Hutch really does nothing functional.

[/size]You can right click a Hutch to spawn additional butterflies. The amount is random. The right click butterflies will only spawn under normal allowed conditions.

[size=4][b]Placing a butterfly hutch outdoors.[/b][/size]
[size=3]The game code for the Butterfly Hutch will spawn butterflies in the rain, snow or wind with debris. That is a bit silly.  
The Hutch game code will spawn butterflies after dark.  
Ambient butterflies do not spawn in those conditions.  
This mod will not spawn butterflies in those conditions and will remove hutch butterflies spawned in those conditions.[/size]
[size=4]
[b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Install via Vortex or unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. [/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config setting management.[/size]

[/list]
[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[size=3]Customizable preferences with built-in config menu (requires [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]).[/size]
[size=3]You may also edit the config.json file directly.[/size]

[size=3]Minimum Indoors:
[/size]The minimum number of butterflies to spawn in the hutch location. A value of zero disables the the mod for indoors.

[size=3]Maximum Indoors:
[/size]The maximum number of butterflies to spawn in the hutch location. If minimum is greater than maximum, then minimum is assigned to maximum.

[size=3]Minimum Outdoors:
[/size]The minimum number of butterflies to spawn in the hutch location. A value of zero disables the the mod for outdoors.

[size=3]Maximum Outdoors:
[/size]The maximum number of butterflies to spawn in the hutch location. If minimum is greater than maximum, then minimum is assigned to maximum.

[size=3]Bat Wings to trade:
[/size]Number of Bat Wings to trade for the Butterfly Hutch at the Desert Trader. Vanilla default is 200.

[size=3]Winter butterflies:
[/size]Spawn butterflies outdoors in winter.

[size=3]Island Butterflies:
[/size]Spawn Ginger Island butterflies indoors on the mainland.

[size=3]Night butterflies:
When disabled. Let indoor butterflies have the evenings off, just like outdoor butterflies.[/size]
